NEW SECTION . 97D.6 Revocation of rights to 1 pension. 2 1. As used in this section: 3 a. “Bona fide retirement” means the retirement of a vested 4 member of the system who is eligible to receive benefits under 5 the system. 6 b. “Conviction” means a plea of guilty or no contest or a 7 verdict of guilty. 8 c. “Public employee” means any individual who is employed by 9 a public employer and is entitled to a pension under chapter 10 97A, 97B, or 602. “Public employee” includes a public official 11 as defined in section 68B.2. 12 d. “Public employer” means the state, its boards, 13 commissions, agencies, and departments, and its political 14 subdivisions including school districts and other special 15 purpose districts. 16 e. “System” means the Iowa department of public safety peace 17 officers’ retirement, accident, and disability system under 18 chapter 97A; the Iowa public employees’ retirement system under 19 chapter 97B; and the judicial retirement system under chapter 20 602. 21 2. In addition to any other penalties provided by law, upon 22 the conviction of a public employee for a felony, the public 23 employee shall lose all rights in and to the public employee’s 24 pension under a system prior to a bona fide retirement and the 25 pension shall be revoked by the system. 26 3. If a public employee is convicted of a felony, the clerk 27 of the district court shall notify the applicable system that 28 a public employee has been so convicted. Any accumulated 29 contributions made by the public employee to the system that 30 have not already been returned to the public employee shall 31 be returned to the public employee. Any benefits received 32 by the public employee in excess of the public employee’s 33 contributions shall be returned to the system. 34 4. Any accumulated 17 contributions made by the public employee to the system shall 18 be returned to the public employee.
